cherry-marquee.$description: Cherry Marquee — Brand accent, heading text, link color, icon stroke, outlined button border, footer headline — vivid warm red used as the single chromatic signal across an otherwise cream-and-white interface

cream-bisque.$description: Cream Bisque — Secondary surface for cards, callout panels, and the cart/bag detail button — warm near-white that reads as paper, not gray

canvas-white.$description: Canvas White — Page background, card surface, input fill, button text on dark

ink-black.$description: Ink Black — Primary body text, icon fills, heavy borders, SVG fill — the only true dark

slate-mid.$description: Slate Mid — Muted secondary text, disabled placeholders, low-emphasis dividers

cervo.$description: Display and headings only. Set extremely tight (line-height 0.75 on the 144px hero, 0.9 on 64-72px) and tracked slightly outward at 0.05em — the condensed letterforms and compressed leading make the headline read as a hand-painted sign rather than a web type block. Weight 400 carries the body, weight 500 amplifies emphasis within the display.

helveticaneuecyr.$description: Body, UI, navigation, footer, input, captions. Light 400 weight throughout with generous 1.3-1.4 leading on running text — the whisper-weight keeps chrome from competing with the Cervo display, so the marquee headline always wins the eye.
